title: Anthropic seeks valuation of about $1.3 trillion when it becomes a publicly traded company
description: Artificial intelligence giant Anthropic is looking for an approximately $1.3 trillion valuation in its initial public offering. The company behind the Claude chatbot said in a regulatory filing on Tuesday that it will sell 825 million shares priced between $70 and $78 a share. That would give Anthropic the ability to raise more than $61 billion, if the IPO is priced at the midpoint. The San Francisco company is anticipated to make its Wall Street debut this month.
